# tcpshield_sentry_tunnel_bind_port (Data Source)

Asks TCPShield for a free Sentry tunnel bind port. The answer changes on every read, so feeding it straight into `tcpshield_sentry_tunnel.bind_port` needs `lifecycle { ignore_changes = [bind_port] }` — otherwise every plan proposes a new port.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "tcpshield_sentry_tunnel_bind_port" "free" {}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `port` (Number) A currently free bind port.
